# Know Your Meme

> > A comprehensive database documenting internet memes, viral trends, and online culture phenomena from platforms like TikTok, Twitter, and YouTube.

Know Your Meme serves as the definitive encyclopedia for understanding the origins, evolution, and cultural impact of viral content across social media platforms. The site provides detailed explanations of meme formats, dance trends, catchphrases, and viral moments that shape online discourse.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Viral dance challenges
- Twitter/X meme culture
- Catchphrases and slang
- Nostalgia memes
- Hood culture references
- DeviantArt and fan art
- YouTube viral content
- Meme format explanations
- Social media crossover trends
- Pop culture commentary
- Music-based memes

## Viral Meme Entries

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring art of girl over cat, viral on TikTok/Twitter
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' song from Atlanta
